memory_candidates.content: When a plan names specific line-numbered anchor occurrences for a rename sweep (e.g. next_dispatch -> follow_up_task), still grep the whole file/repo for the pattern after applying the named edits — related field-description or inline-usage occurrences at unlisted locations are easy to miss, and Phase-4-style repo-wide verification greps will catch them anyway. Better to catch during the phase than at final verification.

Pattern for relaxing a categorical hard-mode prohibition into a conditional exception: (1) identify every file that inline-restates the policy rather than @-referencing it, (2) establish canonical wording in the base/override contract file first, (3) propagate consistent wording to each restating agent file, (4) run repo-wide greps for both the old absolute phrasing and the old field names as the final verification gate. Used successfully to reconcile lean/cslib hard-mode contracts with a relaxed core zero-debt policy (task 806, building on task 778).
